comment: Eleven parameters and four inputs are declared with no widget on the panel and can never be clicked: the four per-lane speed knobs, loop and invert for lanes two to four (the panel pair is shared and follows the selected lane), the two advance buttons, and the four speed CV inputs. The manual's Connections section lists SPEED 1-4 CV among the inputs, which is true of the code and not of the panel. The two large knobs are printed PARAM I and PARAM II on the panel; the manual calls them SPEED and PHASE.
